what: P18: lock-free long import members. Writer::read of an archive member does not know its archive, so pe.rs keeps every archive descriptor (__IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR_<lib> -> DLL) in Pe::descriptors: Mutex, locked once per long import member (thousands for windows.lib, serialising the parallel member reads). Add NativeKind::Member { archive } (or an Option<&Archive> argument to Writer::read) and Archive::descriptors: Vec<(Name, Name)> filled by the writer when it reads the archive, so the PE writer looks the DLL up without a lock.
